approvalReference: User selected acceptance in the webserver aggregation review form in Copilot session 5d48e2ad-f67d-4314-b990-7eb2db60a695
decision: Accept PT1H with the native 4-hour per-device aggregate; keep the query and record the event-context limitation
limitations: The native four-hour ingestion-based lookback can add command lines and alter representative values in each per-device aggregate compared with Sentinel's one-hour period; aggregation and timing parity are not established.
DeviceId and DeviceName are retained, but summarize drops Timestamp and ReportId. Precise event timing and process enrichment are not established.
All source tactics remain in YAML; the current packaging boundary emits only the first tactic.
